Shortcuts the model takes

Simplifications applied to these cards; they play a little better or worse than in a real game.

Treated as producing any color
Lotus Field, Opaline Unicorn, Transguild Promenade
Mana creatures can tap for mana the turn they arrive
Opaline Unicorn
Equipment text beyond its bonus is ignored
Leather Armor, Plate Armor
Fetch lands find a land that enters tapped, in your main phase
Evolving Wilds
Hybrid and Phyrexian costs paid with one color
Norn's Annex
Extra card text ignored
